heading: Measuring instrument catalogues
metaDescription: Measuring instrument and gauge catalogues from JIE. Open a catalogue on this site and enquire on WhatsApp for specifications and pricing.
intro: JIE supplies measuring instruments and spares from leading brands, and provides calibration, expert repair and servicing for all major brands of measuring instruments.
Each catalogue opens on this site, and every instrument in it can be enquired on WhatsApp for specifications and pricing.
